payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulate happiness spread day-by-day for a fixed large number of days (10013) to cover all possible boy-girl pair interactions, then check if all friends are happy.
payload.rationale: The solution simulates the process exhaustively rather than performing a traditional search. Among the given complete_search subtypes, BFS/DFS graph traversal is conceptually the closest approach for reachability in the bipartite friendship graph.
